description: Photos taken with your smartphone or tablet are automatically stored on your PC. PicStream is a feature of Acer Photo that backs up photos taken from your smartphone or tablet to your computer over a wireless or mobile network. Acer Photo also organizes your photos in folders according to the month that the photos were taken, so browsing your pics is easier than ever. Plus, Acer Photo is free! For more details, please visit the Acer Apps official website: http://www.acer.com/acercloud
